about.label: About
about.title: Code that survives the <accent>next release</accent>
about.p1: Computer Science graduate building scalable, resilient web and mobile apps on React, Next.js and Node.js — always TypeScript.
about.p2: I care about the why behind architecture — from authentication and access control to data models and automated tests — balancing fast delivery with code that won't hurt later.

solutions.label: What I build
solutions.title: Not just a stack, but <accent>problems solved</accent>
solutions.subtitle: Six areas I've already shipped to production.

s1.title: High-Performance Full-Stack Interfaces
s1.desc: Scalable front-ends wired to Node.js and Prisma back-ends, tuned for DX and performance.
s1.b1: SSR and SSG with Next.js for peak performance and SEO.
s1.b2: Componentized UI with TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui and React.
s1.b3: Type-safe validation with Zod, TanStack Query and React Hook Form.

s2.title: Smart TV & Digital Signage
s2.desc: Smart TV apps in React Native TVOS with real-time WebSockets and remotely managed content.
s2.b1: Interfaces adapted for remote control and TV experience.
s2.b3: Digital signage and integrated medical testing systems.

s3.title: Gamification & Engagement
s3.desc: Gamification with haptics, achievements, social feeds and rankings for sports coaching.
s3.b1: Haptic feedback and animations for immersive experiences.
s3.b3: Social feeds and real-time interactions between users.

s4.title: Fintech & Admin Dashboards
s4.desc: B2B dashboards with Pix checkout, subscriptions and visual training-plan builders.
s4.b1: Pix checkout integration and subscription management.
s4.b2: Admin dashboards with analytics and access control.
s4.b3: Visual training plan builder for coaches.

s5.title: Logistics & Tracking
s5.desc: The full logistics flow: customer app, control panel and delivery-person interface.
s5.b1: Customer app for orders and real-time tracking.
s5.b2: Control panel for delivery and route management.
s5.b3: Delivery person app with confirmation and status updates.

s6.title: Authentication & Security
s6.desc: Secure auth and access control — from production RBAC to OAuth2, JWT rotation and Cognito.
s6.b1: Role-based access control and input validation on production routes.
s6.b2: OAuth2 and JWT with access/refresh token rotation.
s6.b3: Serverless auth with AWS Cognito, Lambda and API Gateway.

borebi.title: Full Stack Development Intern
borebi.description:

- Digitalized paper-based public workflows and run deployment and evolutionary maintenance in production.

solidTech.title: Full Stack Developer
solidTech.description:
- Scalable full-stack ecosystems: **React/Next.js** front-ends on **Node.js/Prisma** back-ends.
- **Smart TV** signage and medical-testing apps in **React Native TVOS** with real-time WebSockets.
- Gamification (haptics, feeds, rankings), B2B dashboards with **Pix** checkout, and full logistics apps.

funprev.title: IT Internship
funprev.description:
- Diagnosed and fixed network, device and infrastructure issues, keeping systems stable and secure.

- Configured hardware, software and network devices, and provided technical support to users.
